profile_text.body:
Palo Alto Networks is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NASDAQ: PANW, CIK 0001327567) that describes itself as a leader in cybersecurity protection and software for modern enterprises. Its site positions the company as serving a range of security professionals, including CISOs, network security engineers, cloud architects, and SOC managers, with offerings built around Zero Trust architecture, threat intelligence, network security, cloud workload protection, and security consulting.

The company's AI product tracked by this site is Palo Alto Networks Precision AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI. The site describes Precision AI as underpinning several platforms: the Strata Network Security Platform, which the company says proactively monitors, analyzes, and prevents sophisticated threats in real time; an AI-driven SecOps platform described as the number one in its category and powered by unified data, artificial intelligence, and automation; and a cloud and AI security platform the company calls the world's most interoperable. The site also introduces Idira, described as a next-generation identity security platform intended to secure every identity for the AI enterprise.

No litigation or MCP server entries are held for the company at this time. The profile was verified on 2026-09-02.
